title: Veterinary Officer
qualification: Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry Science from a recognized University, Should have knowledge of any of the State Languages, Should be conversant with the customs and usages of Sikkim

title: Junior Research Fellow (JRF) and Field cum Laboratory Assistant
qualification: M.Tech/M.E. in Food Process Engineering or related fields with NET, Graduation with knowledge of English, Nepali and Hindi
salary: Junior Research Fellow (JRF):₹ 37,000/- per month plus HRA as applicable (₹ 42,000/- per month plus HRA after satisfactory performance of 2 years) || Field cum Laboratory Assistant:₹ 15,000/- per month fixed
age_limit: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years for all posts. || Age relaxation will be as per government rules.

title: Faculty
application_fee: Fees must be paid online only via the gateway provided on the institute website. || UR / OBC / EWS:₹1500. || Women / SC / ST / PwD:₹750.
selection_process: The selection involves multiple stages: || Scrutiny and shortlisting based on credit point scores and academic/research performance. || A written test and/or presentation. || A final personal interview before the Selection Committee. || Note: Candidates must appear in person; no TA/DA will be provided.
